user_authorized_change: Increase concurrency to finish existing supplemental experiments faster; retain the USD 200 total ceiling
dispatch_policy: Frozen remaining order, max four independent processes; never pick by observed outcomes
legacy_handoff: Stop only the old coordinator; allow its already-paid child to finish and commit naturally before launching parallel workers
accounting_policy: One coordinator publishes canonical result/ledger prefixes; independent journal, receipts, tickets and worker artifacts retain actual dispatch/start/completion times
budget_policy: Every launch uses fresh authoritative balance and reserves active workers, completed unpublished costs, all undispatched tail and unknown failed-call reservations
per_call_budget_guard: New operational safety guard can censor a cell at its reserved cap; such a cell is terminal BudgetStop invalid and must be reported separately, never interpreted as a prior-effect failure
